resources.string: Enter this code in the phone app after choosing Direct
Local address: %1$s Port: %2$d\nDiscovery port: %3$d\nWeb remote: http://%1$s:%4$d https://%1$s:%5$d
Scan to open the web remote (phone and box on the same Wi-Fi)

Add this page to the phone home screen for one-tap access:
 iOS (Safari): Share → Add to Home Screen
 HarmonyOS (Huawei Browser): Menu → Add to home screen
 Android (Chrome / Edge): Menu → Install app / Add to Home Screen
Note: iOS Safari cannot vibrate on web pages; on HarmonyOS and Android,
enable system "Touch vibration" or buttons will not vibrate.
Accessibility service: off (tap to enable, required for remote control)
Injection: accessibility (OK to switch to ADB)
ADB debugging: connected (real key events, same as Bluetooth)
ADB debugging: not connected (OK to open developer options)
ADB debugging: off (OK to try enabling)
Turn on "Developer options → USB debugging / ADB debugging", then press OK here to connect
Display guard: %1$s not recovered, power-cycle the box

First run: enable "TV Remote Service" in system Settings → Accessibility. No root required.
Then choose "Direct" or "BT" in the phone app and enter the 6-digit pairing code above.
The service starts automatically on every boot (including after power loss).

If apps that only react to real key events (e.g. cloud TV players) must be controlled,
switch "Injection" to ADB and enable ADB debugging in Developer options
(the TV asks once to allow the connection).
Receives remote commands from the phone and performs back, home, D-pad, volume and text input actions.
Download complete. Confirm the installation in the system dialog
